name: Cynthia Jelagat
bio: Cynthia Jelagat founded Clean Heights Initiative and leads its community environmental work in Elgeyo Marakwet.
quote: Our heights are only as clean as the hands that tend to them.

name: Roy Chumba
bio: Roy Chumba is a student at the Catholic University of Eastern Africa, Gaba Campus. He supports Clean Heights Initiative's information technology and website work.
